tools.name: get_fulfillment_proof
tools.description: Free: show live Tech-World worker heartbeat, background inventory production, current verified feed status and actual completed paid-job counts. Internal inventory work is explicitly excluded from revenue.

tools.name: get_live_inventory
tools.description: Free: list PaidHandshake premium data feeds with quality status, counts, freshness, current prices and sample URLs.

tools.name: get_free_data_sample
tools.description: Free: return one verified, quality-gated sample when available from any sellable PaidHandshake data feed.

tools.name: search_matches
tools.description: Search current public or authorized information for a lawful intent. Returns one evidence-bearing proof source, locked previews, pricing, and a reusable search_id.

tools.name: get_unlock_quote
tools.description: Get current prices for unlocking additional ranked results from an existing PaidHandshake search.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL for a PaidHandshake result package. The tool never silently charges a buyer.

tools.name: quote_paid_machine_job
tools.description: Free: quote almost any lawful public-data/public-web research, sourcing, verification or commercial-intelligence task before a machine spends anything. Unknown task labels are routed to a compatible worker capability.

tools.name: get_machine_payment_options
tools.description: Free: return active and activation-ready machine payment rails, including Stripe-funded delegated wallets and x402 Base-USDC endpoints when activated.

tools.name: get_machine_onboarding
tools.description: Return self-service enrollment, Stripe wallet funding, paid-job, watch and polling endpoints for autonomous buyers.

tools.name: submit_paid_machine_job
tools.description: Authenticated phm_ agents can submit custom or standard lawful paid work with max_price_cents. PaidHandshake preserves the requested task, routes execution to a compatible advertised worker capability, and auto-authorizes only inside delegated wallet, per-call, daily, monthly and platform limits.

tools.name: get_paid_machine_job
tools.description: Poll a paid machine job using the authenticated phm_ bearer token.

tools.name: create_recurring_paid_watch
tools.description: Authenticated: create a recurring watch. Each run is a normal paid machine job bounded by max_price_cents and all delegated spending limits. Minimum cadence is 60 minutes.

tools.name: list_recurring_paid_watches
tools.description: Authenticated: list recurring watches for the machine buyer.

tools.name: set_recurring_paid_watch
tools.description: Authenticated: enable or disable a recurring paid watch.

tools.name: get_machine_wallet
tools.description: Return wallet balance and delegated spending limits for the authenticated machine.

tools.name: get_paidhandshake_capabilities
tools.description: Describe verified data feeds, machine endpoints, payment behavior, and operating principles.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Create a Stripe Checkout URL for a PaidHandshake result package. The tool never silently charges a buyer.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_paid_machine_job" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Poll a paid machine job using the authenticated phm_ bearer token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_free_data_sample, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job · Destructive: create_recurring_paid_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_fulfillment_proof, get_live_inventory, get_free_data_sample, get_paidhandshake_capabilities · Private data: get_machine_onboarding, submit_paid_machine_job, get_paid_machine_job, get_machine_wallet · Public sink: submit_paid_machine_job · Destructive: create_recurring_paid_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
